text:
Type: seagrass storage basket, set of three
Use: storing blankets, toys, magazines; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: bohemian, coastal, modern
Materials: woven seagrass, black metal wire
Colors: warm natural tan, black
Shape: round straight-sided basket with a V-shaped cutout filled with chevron wire lines, nesting sizes, medium and sturdy
Feel: warm, natural, textured, relaxed
Goes with: light wood, white or cream walls, black accents, linen textiles; bohemian, coastal or Scandinavian rooms

product.name: Stone & Beam Modern Round Seagrass Storage Basket Set - Pack of 3 (Renewed)
product.description: You'll wonder how you ever managed without these versatile baskets. They hold blankets, throws and magazines -- even the assorted items you hid quickly before your mother-in-law arrived. When not in use, they fit inside one another for easy storage. Large: 14.6" W x 15.7" D x 13" H; Medium: 12.2" W x 13.8" D x 11.8" H; Small: 10.2" W x 11.8" D x 11" H Gold metal accents on the sides add decorative elements to your room along with storage space Seagrass and metal mesh; gold metal accents; convenient openings to use as side handles When not in use, they stack inside one another to save space
